reviews.x: I've only had 1 different brand of these silicone sponges before, so I don't have much experience to compare these to. I did, however, like my previous one better because the silicone was a little more firm. These were almost a little *too* flexible/soft and "squishy" for my taste, but I believe that's probably a matter of personal preference. They are also a tad bit smaller than my last one. Still giving a rating of 4 stars; you can't beat the price of these and they definitely still wo

reviews.t: feels like chicken, works like a charm!
reviews.x: So I purchased this product after trying to order some of these sili sponges during the prime day deals which failed miserably. I have had this product for only a few days now, and I have to say that I absolutely love it. I feel like it is super easy to use, and blends my makeup super well. It's a weird concept -  putting silicone on your face feels like chicken cutlets. But I'd recommend these to anyone. I even have gotten a few of my friends to start using them instead of their beauty blenders

reviews.t: Not worth the few dollars I spent
reviews.x: It's not very obvious in the pictures provided, but it's not a seamless piece of silicone. There's a seam around the edges that clings to makeup and leaves streaks. The protruding seams are a bad idea considering one might use this around the eyes as well. I ended up returning this item for a refund.

reviews.t: Applies foundation terribly. Stick to a brush or sponge
reviews.x: Applies foundation terribly. Stick to a brush or sponge. I had the brilliant idea of using it for my skincare instead so I wasn't touching my face so much.... but it broke me out. Silisponges are not for me.

reviews.t: I feel like I'm smearing makeup around my face using this
reviews.x: One popped open at the seam, so the jelly inside keeps poking out. Maybe it takes some time to get used to but it doesn't seem to blend well. I feel like I'm smearing makeup around my face using this.
I hate these. They’re so hard to use and they don’t blend foundation at all. If you don’t want to waste foundation, it’s great because they don’t absorb anything, but thats all.
Love using these to apply foundation. I use a considerably less amount of foundation when using this product

I feel bad writing this because it's not about the seller.  It was shipped on time and in a protected bubble-wrapped pkg.  The low score is for the product itself.  For me, all it did was slide my foundation over the very surface of my skin.  No blending.  I even tried using it with foundation and no moisturizer first, and it just didn't work for me.  I used it for concealer and for some reason it "tugged" at my skin too much.  Interesting concept, but I can't use it.

LOVE these! I never really use foundation, BB/CC cremes are more my style and these work great for what I wear. The only thing I would say is that I can't wear primer and then use these because it leaves a white cast on my face because I guess it isn't made to blend primer in, so that's not really its fault. For the people saying that it leaves their face streaky and gross, try using less makeup and dotting your face first and then blending it with the sponge.

reviews.t: Film separates and causes uneven application
reviews.x: I’m disappointed that these silicon makeup sponges didn’t live up to my expectations. When they arrived the packaging was great and they look like they were made out of good quality material. However, upon first use the film on the sponge started to separate and fold making the application uneven and sloppy. Overall, it was worth the try but wouldn’t buy again.

reviews.t: I tried them because everyone was like wow you should try these
reviews.x: I don't know what all the hype is about with these. I tried them because everyone was like wow you should try these.  And I used more foundation than I would normally use just to get it on my face.  I had to finally throw them away and just use my brush and fingers to put my foundation on.  I used so much less doing it my way.  I just don't like these.

If you aren't having success with it, it's you, not the applicator. Just keep trying. Start by dabbing your foundation all around your face and then use the applicator to smoothly apply all over. You must be using too mush foundation in one spot. I love these applicators, I get so many compliments on my makeup since I started using them.

It works very well! It blends well, easy to wipe product off of it, saves LOTS OF PRODUCT.  My only concern is that it feels like it will break easily.  I'm not sure if that is just me but I feel like I have to be careful when I use it and I feel like if I drag it the outer wrap of it will stretch out and then it will look wrinkly.

reviews.t: Odd feel, great for make up
reviews.x: I guess I’m just used to the normal make up sponge, because these felt weird to me. I also left them sitting on my vanity and the sun shinning in my window made them shrink in size. They also feel like there’s a piece of plastic around them, but it’s just the way they are made. As far as spreading make up evenly, they work great

I was pleasantly surprised with this amazing product! Applies evenly, smoothly, and doesn't make your foundation look cakey or flakey! No more wasting pump after pump of foundation only for your brushes or blenders to soak most of it up.

reviews.t: You have to use alot of product (foundation) in order to get good coverage with this tool
reviews.x: Must be used with light stroking motion. You have to use alot of product (foundation) in order to get good coverage with this tool. The pros are that its easy to clean and does not hold bacteria like sponges and brushes do.

reviews.t: Makeup didn't go on smooth at all.
reviews.x: I didn't like these at all. The price was excellent. I was excited to get these, but my makeup don't go on even at all. Tried several times and used with different makeup.  Went back to using my sponge and make up brushes.

I love these... I am able to put my product on without wasting so much like I sponge would, and I get a more even coverage. Sometimes I have to blend in product with a foundation brush, but the results are fantastic.
I use this everyday! It’s an interesting texture, but it blends foundation beautifully. Although one of my blenders came ripped and that’s why I took off a star, still an amazing product!
I love these makeup sponges. I have never used them before and decided to give it a go. I'm amazed at how well they blend my makeup. I'm using less than I have had to. Very neat product.

reviews.t: While these did a very good job at conserving my foundation it left a smudgy ...
reviews.x: While these did a very good job at conserving my foundation it left a smudgy not blended look. I've already switched back to my traditional foam blender to get a more natural look
There soft, not really what I was expecting for sure! But there cute and worth the money, I’ll have to try them out tomorrow on my Snapchat live! Follow me at Firecracker.420  💋💋
I bought these for applying foundation, they work good and no make up is wasted. It took me a bit to get used to them, it is so different then a makeup blender or brush.
These do not blend well at all. Had to look up instructions on YouTube to ensure proper application. These do not conserve makeup due to blending issues.
I got my mother this for her birthday and she loves them and the way they apply her make up with little to no make up left of the silicone.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the sponge does not blend foundation well, leaving makeup smeared or streaky on the surface of the skin.
Several reviewers praise the product for saving foundation because it doesn't absorb product and applies makeup smoothly and evenly.
Some reviewers report durability problems, including seams separating, the film peeling, or the outer wrap feeling like it will break or stretch.
A few reviewers find the silicone material too soft, squishy, or odd-feeling compared to a normal makeup sponge.
Some reviewers note issues with primer or skincare use, such as a white cast when used over primer or breakouts when used for skincare.
